name: Pink World: A Bimbofication Visual Novel
source:
Your routine life changes forever as you're awoken to a flash of pink light with the rise of the sun.

A small standalone game with the concept from my bimbofication comic ''Pink World", where everyone under the pink sky is slowly turned into hot studs and sluts. Though your words have an influence in what direction they change.

[From [url=https://annon.itch.io/pinkworld]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你在太阳升起时被一道粉红色的光芒叫醒时，你的日常生活将永远改变。

一款小型独立游戏，其概念来自于我的漫画漫画《粉红世界》，粉红天空下的每个人都慢慢变成了辣妹和荡妇。尽管你的话语会影响他们改变的方向。

[来自[url=https://annon.itch.io/pinkworld]Itch.io[/url]]
